description: Header file defining CUDA RNG generator classes and related utilities for managing CUDA graph-safe RNG states in PyTorch.

classes.name: CUDAGeneratorState
classes.description: Manages CUDA RNG state, including seed, offsets, and graph registration for graph-safe RNG operations.

classes.name: CUDAGeneratorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CUDA RNG generator, supporting seed, offset, state management, and graph registration.

methods.name: increase
methods.description: Increases the generator's offset by a specified amount.

methods.name: register_graph
methods.description: Registers a CUDA graph with the generator.

methods.name: unregister_graph
methods.description: Unregisters a CUDA graph from the generator.

methods.name: capture_prologue
methods.description: Prepares the generator for graph capture.

methods.name: capture_epilogue
methods.description: Returns the total offset increment after graph capture.

methods.name: replay_prologue
methods.description: Replays the generator's state before graph execution.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the generator state.

methods.name: set_current_seed
methods.description: Sets the generator's seed.

methods.name: set_offset
methods.description: Sets the generator's offset.

methods.name: get_offset
methods.description: Retrieves the current offset.

methods.name: current_seed
methods.description: Returns the current seed.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Returns the seed value.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the generator's internal state.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the generator's internal state.

methods.name: graphsafe_set_state
methods.description: Sets the generator state in a graph-safe manner.

methods.name: graphsafe_get_state
methods.description: Gets the generator state in a graph-safe manner.

methods.name: set_philox_offset_per_thread
methods.description: Sets the per-thread offset for Philox RNG.

methods.name: philox_offset_per_thread
methods.description: Gets the per-thread offset for Philox RNG.

methods.name: philox_cuda_state
methods.description: Generates a PhiloxCudaState with a specified increment and updates current state.

methods.name: reset_rnn_state
methods.description: Resets RNN state if not already reset.

methods.name: philox_engine_inputs
methods.description: Provides incremental engine inputs for Philox RNG.

methods.name: device_type
methods.description: Returns the device type (CUDA).

methods.name: clone_impl
methods.description: Clones the generator implementation.
